title: Large Language Models as Information Sources: Distinctive Characteristics and Types of Low-Quality Information

bias_targets.target: Healthcare and social bias (Medical racism, victim blaming, and disease stigma)
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation via focus groups and think-aloud sessions with public health professionals and individuals with lived experiences, analyzing LLM responses to sensitive health-related queries.
Thematic analysis of focus group discussions identifying instances where LLM outputs are based on outdated data or fail to accurately reflect the diversity and complexity of marginalized populations.
